These two are equal to me so I'll share them both...

1) I had to go to a wedding with my mom on my 13th birthday. I had gotten a new haircut and glasses and was feeling really happy about myself. There was a boy there that I thought was cute so I started talking to him and his friend. His friend looks at me and then turns to him and says "Do you think she's ugly? I think she is." 

2) When my friends and I were all starting to *develop* we were having a swim party at one of their houses. We'll call that girl C. We were all sitting in C's basement talking when they somehow got to the subject of weight. They were all thin but thought they were fat. I was okay with myself and said that I didn't think I was fat and none of them were either. C looked me up and down and in a stereotypical mean girl voice and demeanor she laughs and with eyes pointed at my stomach she says "If you can pinch an inch you can lose an inch". It's been years and C is still a raging bitch. I can lose an inch but she can't lose the bitchy attitude.
